# Marleina

> Ventrue Primogen and the clear favourite to succeed [[Calebros]]. She wins the election unless the player makes that impossible.

## Appearance

Fortyish, severe, expensively plain. Marleina dresses like a managing partner and speaks like one, in short sentences that end conversations.

## Personality

Competent, controlled, and genuinely convinced she would be good for the city. She is not wrong, which makes her harder to oppose. She pays her debts promptly and collects them the same way.

## Role in Campaign 1

- Building her majority on the Primogen one favour at a time.
- Has the Toreador vote through [[Rene Valentine]] and is working on the Brujah.
- Regards the tunnels as a Nosferatu problem and would rather not know more. This is her blind spot.
- Will offer a competent neonate a job. The job is real; so are the strings.

## Stats (summary)

Ninth generation; blood pool 14, spends up to 2 blood per turn. Dominate 4, Presence 3, Fortitude 2. Willpower 8, Humanity 6. Travels with two ghouls and a lawyer.
